$comment: Store caption copy, English. Deliberately NOT in locales/: that tree is the APP's catalogs, held to a three-place language roster and a coverage projection by scripts/check-i18n-coverage.mjs, and this text is read by a store reviewer rather than rendered by any screen. Keyed by frame id from scripts/lib/store-shots/story.mjs, and asserted in both directions by the unit spec.

notes.headline: Notes that stay yours.
notes.sub: Plain markdown underneath, so the file outlives the app.

markdown.headline: Write in plain markdown.
markdown.sub: Wikilinks, backlinks and live preview, with no proprietary format.

find.headline: Find anything, offline.
find.sub: Full-text search and the graph, computed on your own machine.

privacy.headline: No email. No tracking.
privacy.sub: Your identity is a 20-character account number. Nothing to sign up for.

server.headline: Sync through your own server.
server.sub: Self-hosted, running the same open code as the app.

cards.label: the same open code you run

agent.headline: Ask your notes anything.
agent.sub: Off until you turn it on. You name the provider, and nothing is sent anywhere until you do.

collab.headline: One vault, shared.
collab.sub: Not your account, and not your other notes.

cards.label: every member's copy opens with the group key
